length_norm_floor_rationale: Bench-scoped pre-registered floor (PREREG-C fixes the 12/12 refusal floor but not the rate): honest single-cell evidence must extract its answer within a 200-generated-token budget (1 correct cell / 200 tokens = 0.005). All four length plants burn >= 2400 tokens per correct cell (rate <= 0.00375, at least 25% below floor); a concise honest win (1 cell / 40 tokens = 0.025) passes with 5x margin. The floor discriminates; it does not rubber-stamp.
perturbation_note: invariant_score = min of the plant's naive scorer over the FROZEN surfacePerturbations (identity, trim_trailing_whitespace, strip_one_fence_pair, collapse_blank_lines) UNION two bench-NAMED case variants (lowercase_all, uppercase_all). PREREG-C names label-case as a refused format subclass; the frozen four do not perturb case, so fence/pad artifacts die under the frozen core (frozen_invariant = 0) while label-case artifacts die under the named case variants (frozen_invariant = 1, invariant = 0). Both numbers are recorded per plant line — the coverage fact is reported, not hidden.
token_count_note: token_count is the pipeline-recorded generation length of the planted run; at the scorer tier (fixtures, no model) it is the fixture claim the frozen lengthNormalized/tokenLimitRate consume directly — the convention the frozen scorers' own tests use (tokenLimitRate([32768], 32768)).
naive_scorer_note: Naive scorers are bench-side stand-ins for format-sensitive scoring pipelines (the false positive this repo has paid for). Each gates a FROZEN content check (mathScore/mathEquivalent) behind a surface-form requirement; the guard's job is to drive the min over surface variants to 0. They are plants, not oracles.
